messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're gating the webinar signup behind a new landing page. Need an SEO preflight: keyword mapping, schema markup (WebinarEvent + FAQ), internal linking sweep, and a redirect plan. Can we get a prioritized checklist by EOD?

sam_seo: Got it. I'll pull a prioritized keyword list and map to funnel stages. Quick q: do we want hero to target 'inference cost optimization' or 'LLM inference platform'?

maria: Aim hero at 'LLM inference platform' (top-funnel). Benchmark narrative should call out cost/perf as subheads. We'll iterate hero copy with A/B variants.

sam_seo: Cool. I'll draft keyword->URL table + canonical recs. Top seed keywords I'm planning: 'LLM inference', 'inference latency optimization', 'dedicated GPU inference', 'inference cost reduction'.

elaine_content: I'll prep two hero variants and three meta description options. For schema: WebinarEvent + FAQ + Organization ok? Any custom properties we should include (e.g., speaker roles, access level)?

jason_dev: We can inject WebinarEvent JSON-LD via the head partial. Example snippet I'll use as a stub: `{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"State of Inference Webinar","startDate":"2025-09-10T16:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/soi"}}` — will PR.

oliver_analytics: When publishing, please include UTMs: utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=organic/email, utm_campaign=soi2025. I'll create goal funnels for registration -> attendance and add a vanity dashboard.

sam_seo: Redirects to plan: `/docs/inference` -> `/resources/inference-guide` (301), archive old SEO slugs. Jason, can you add a redirect map? Also want to check internal links from product pages to the new landing.

jason_dev: I'll add 301 map in infra repo. Quick paste for ops: `
/docs/inference -> /resources/inference-guide
/blog/latency-playbook -> /resources/latency-guide
` . Will run site link-checker after deploy.

maria: Prioritization for the checklist: 1) hero keyword + meta (owners: sam, elaine) 2) WebinarEvent schema (owner: jason) 3) redirects (sam/jason) 4) internal linking (jason/elaine) 5) analytics and UTM wiring (oliver). Assign owners?

sam_seo: I'll own 1 & 3. ETA EOD for the keyword table, EOW for redirect PR.

elaine_content: I'll own hero variants + meta copy. ETA tomorrow noon.

jason_dev: I'll own internal linking + redirect PR. PR by tomorrow EOD. Will coordinate rollout window with eng-platform.

oliver_analytics: I'll own analytics setup + UTM spec. ETA Friday; will confirm dashboards and event names.

maria: :thumbsup: Two extra asks — 1) add a small eval prompt set in Redwood Optimize to catch any quality regressions after content/redirect changes; 2) annotate CTAs with data-action attributes for easier eventing.

sam_seo: Good call. I'll put together 10 seed queries for the eval and map expected SERP intent buckets.

elaine_content: Quick Q — for internal linking, prefer a persistent banner or contextual CTAs inside docs? Which should be prioritized?

jason_dev: Persistent banner is fastest to deploy; contextual CTAs are better for relevance and SEO. Recommend banner first, then contextual CTAs in follow-up sprint.

marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar-deck upload due 2025-09-03 09:00 UTC. :calendar:

maria: Added to roadmap. Let's sync tomorrow 10:00am to confirm progress. Ping here if anything blocks.

sam_seo: PR uploaded for keyword table: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/289 — CSV + canonical recommendations. @jason_dev can you review the redirect list in the PR?

jason_dev: Reviewing now. Found one old slug to check: `/pricing/inference` — product wants to keep it live. I'll mark that redirect as a 302 for now and flag product.

oliver_analytics: Events spec draft: trigger 'register' event on data-action=webinar-register, category=webinar, label=soi2025, value=0. Will paste full spec into the analytics doc.

elaine_content: Landing copy A/B uploaded to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/soi/landing-drafts — comments welcome.

maria: Great progress. I'll compile the final checklist and post to #launch-playbooks once everything's merged. :raised_hands:

sam_seo: Added the eval seed queries to the PR and linked a small SERP intent rubric.

jason_dev: Redirect PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/502 — includes 301 map + link-checker results. Please review.

oliver_analytics: Dashboard stub created and shared with the thread. Will add goal IDs after events are live.

maria: Closing the loop for today — thanks all. We will reconvene after PR reviews. If any blockers pop up, drop them here.
